props.animation_script:
// ============================================================================

// ONI Custom Event Helper (emit) – minimal inline version

// This makes ONI.emit(eventName, payload) available if it isn't already.

// ============================================================================

globalThis.ONI = globalThis.ONI ?? {};

if (!ONI.emit) {

// Default: LOCAL ONLY (perfect for UI-ish things like animationStart/End)

ONI.emit = function (eventName, payload = {}, options = {}) {

const { local = true, world = false } = options;

if (local) Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

if (world) game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

// When you REALLY want to broadcast something across all clients

// (e.g. game-state changes, global cutscene flags), use this:

ONI.emitWorld = function (eventName, payload = {}) {

Hooks.callAll(eventName, payload);

game.socket.emit("world", { action: eventName, payload });

};

if (!ONI._worldRx) {

ONI._worldRx = (data) => {

if (!data?.action) return;

Hooks.callAll(data.action, data.payload);

};

game.socket.on("world", ONI._worldRx);

}

console.log("[ONI Events] Helper installed.");

}

/**

* JRPG Lightning Breath Spell – Foundry VTT v12 + Sequencer + JB2A

* (wired to your system via oni:animationStart / oni:animationEnd events)

*

* - Source: selected token

* - Targets: ALL Foundry targets (multi-target supported)

* - Uses your spell cutscene template:

* dim screen, hide name/bars, fade out others, soft-pan to caster, play beams+impacts, pan back, restore

* - Emits oni:animationStart / oni:animationEnd (LOCAL ONLY) using ONI.emit

*/

(async () => {

if (!game.modules.get("sequencer")?.active) {

return ui.notifications.error("Sequencer module is not active.");

}

const sourceToken = canvas.tokens.controlled[0];

const targets = Array.from(game.user.targets ?? []);

if (!sourceToken) return ui.notifications.warn("Select a token first.");

if (!targets.length) return ui.notifications.warn("Target at least 1 token first (use Foundry's targeting system).");

// --- DEBUG: macro start --------------------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI LightningBreath] START",

"source:", sourceToken.name, `(${sourceToken.id})`,

"targets:", targets.map(t => `${t.name}(${t.id})`).join(", "),

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- Broadcast: Animation START (LOCAL ONLY) ----------------------------

ONI.emit("oni:animationStart", {

type: "spellLightningBreath",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// --- Tunables -----------------------------------------------------------

const fadeDuration = 400; // ms for token fade in/out

const dimAlpha = 0.6; // opacity for the screen dim

const dimFadeDuration = 300; // ms for dimmer fade in/out

const panDuration = 600; // ms to pan toward caster

const panBackDuration = 600; // ms to pan back

const spellDelay = 300; // ms before VFX after pan finishes

const impactDelay = 500; // ms after spell start to play impact

// Impact tint only (beam has NO tint)

const impactPurpleTint = "#E36BFF";

// Origin offset (your preferred values)

const lightningOriginOffsetX = 350; // world +X

const lightningOriginOffsetY = 150; // world +Y

// Scales

const spellScale = 1.25;

const impactScale = 0.55;

// Assets

const dimImageFile = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/ScreenDimmer.png";

const castSoundFile = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Cast1.ogg";

const breathSoundFile = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Laser2.ogg";

const impactSoundFile = "https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Thunder8.ogg";

const spellVfxFile =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Template/Line/Breath_Weapon/BreathWeapon_Lightning01_Regular_Blue_30ft_Line_Burst_1200x200.webm";

const impactVfxFile =

"modules/JB2A_DnD5e/Library/Generic/Impact/Impact_12_Regular_Blue_400x400.webm";

// --- Helper: get active combat tokens (fallback: all placeables) --------

const activeCombat = game.combats?.active;

let combatTokens = [];

if (activeCombat) {

for (const c of activeCombat.combatants) {

const tok = canvas.tokens.get(c.tokenId);

if (tok) combatTokens.push(tok);

}

} else {

combatTokens = canvas.tokens.placeables.slice();

}

// Everyone except source & ALL targets will be faded out

const keepIds = new Set([sourceToken.id, ...targets.map(t => t.id)]);

const others = combatTokens.filter(t => !keepIds.has(t.id));

// Store original opacity so we can restore it

const originalOpacity = new Map();

for (const t of others) originalOpacity.set(t.id, t.alpha ?? 1);

// --- Store & hide token nameplates + resource bars for ALL combat tokens -

const tokenDisplaySettings = new Map();

for (const t of combatTokens) {

const doc = t.document;

tokenDisplaySettings.set(t.id, {

displayName: doc.displayName,

displayBars: doc.displayBars

});

}

if (combatTokens.length > 0) {

const hideUpdates = combatTokens.map(t => ({

_id: t.id,

displayName: CONST.TOKEN_DISPLAY_MODES.NONE,

displayBars: CONST.TOKEN_DISPLAY_MODES.NONE

}));

await canvas.scene.updateEmbeddedDocuments("Token", hideUpdates);

}

// --- Start screen dimmer as a Sequencer effect BELOW tokens -------------

new Sequence()

.effect(dimImageFile)

.atLocation(sourceToken)

.scale(40)

.belowTokens()

.opacity(dimAlpha)

.persist()

.name("oni-spell-dimmer")

.fadeIn(dimFadeDuration)

.fadeOut(dimFadeDuration)

.play();

// --- Fade out everyone except source & targets --------------------------

if (others.length > 0) {

const fadeOutSeq = new Sequence();

for (const t of others) {

fadeOutSeq.animation().on(t).opacity(0).duration(fadeDuration);

}

await fadeOutSeq.play();

}

// --- Store original view (to pan back with Sequencer later) -------------

const originalView = canvas.getViewPosition

? canvas.getViewPosition()

: {

x: canvas.stage.pivot.x,

y: canvas.stage.pivot.y,

scale: canvas.stage.scale.x

};

// Soft pan toward source

const sourceCenter = sourceToken.center;

const panFactor = 0.35;

const panTarget = {

x: originalView.x + (sourceCenter.x - originalView.x) * panFactor,

y: originalView.y + (sourceCenter.y - originalView.y) * panFactor

};

// Origin point with your offset

const originPoint = {

x: sourceToken.center.x + lightningOriginOffsetX,

y: sourceToken.center.y + lightningOriginOffsetY

};

// --- DEBUG: before main Sequence ----------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI LightningBreath] Playing main Sequence",

"spellVfxFile:", spellVfxFile,

"impactVfxFile:", impactVfxFile,

"originPoint:", originPoint,

"impactDelay:", impactDelay,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- Main sequence: pan in -> spell -> impacts -> pan back --------------

const seq = new Sequence();

// 1) Pan slightly toward source

seq.canvasPan()

.atLocation(panTarget)

.duration(panDuration)

.scale(originalView.scale)

.waitUntilFinished();

if (spellDelay > 0) seq.wait(spellDelay);

// 2) Spell sounds

seq.sound()

.file(castSoundFile)

.volume(0.9);

seq.sound()

.file(breathSoundFile)

.volume(0.9)

.delay(3000);

// 3) Lightning breath beam for EACH target (NO TINT on beam)

// Add all beams; only the last one waits so they overlap instead of serializing.

targets.forEach((t, i) => {

const isLast = i === targets.length - 1;

const e = seq.effect()

.file(spellVfxFile)

.atLocation(originPoint)

.rotateTowards(t)

.scale(spellScale);

if (isLast) e.waitUntilFinished(0.5);

});

// 4) Impact sound ONCE + Impact VFX for EACH target (impact stays tinted purple)

seq.sound()

.file(impactSoundFile)

.delay(impactDelay)

.volume(0.9);

for (const t of targets) {

seq.effect()

.file(impactVfxFile)

.atLocation(t)

.delay(impactDelay)

.tint(impactPurpleTint)

.scale(impactScale);

}

// 5) Pan back

seq.canvasPan()

.atLocation({ x: originalView.x, y: originalView.y })

.duration(panBackDuration)

.scale(originalView.scale)

.waitUntilFinished();

await seq.play();

// --- DEBUG: after main Sequence completes -------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI LightningBreath] Main Sequence complete for",

sourceToken.name, "->", targets.map(t => t.name).join(", "),

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

// --- Fade everyone back in ----------------------------------------------

if (others.length > 0) {

const fadeInSeq = new Sequence();

for (const t of others) {

fadeInSeq.animation()

.on(t)

.opacity(originalOpacity.get(t.id) ?? 1)

.duration(fadeDuration);

}

await fadeInSeq.play();

}

// --- Restore token nameplates + resource bars ---------------------------

if (tokenDisplaySettings.size > 0) {

const restoreUpdates = [];

for (const t of combatTokens) {

const saved = tokenDisplaySettings.get(t.id);

if (!saved) continue;

restoreUpdates.push({

_id: t.id,

displayName: saved.displayName,

displayBars: saved.displayBars

});

}

if (restoreUpdates.length > 0) {

await canvas.scene.updateEmbeddedDocuments("Token", restoreUpdates);

}

}

// --- End the dimmer effect so it fades out nicely ------------------------

if (globalThis.Sequencer?.EffectManager) {

Sequencer.EffectManager.endEffects({ name: "oni-spell-dimmer" });

}

// --- Broadcast: Animation END (LOCAL ONLY) -------------------------------

ONI.emit("oni:animationEnd", {

type: "spellLightningBreath",

sourceTokenId: sourceToken.id,

targetTokenIds: targets.map(t => t.id),

sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null,

timestamp: Date.now()

}, { local: true, world: false });

// --- DEBUG: macro end ----------------------------------------------------

console.log(

"[ONI LightningBreath] END",

"source:", sourceToken.name,

"time:", new Date().toISOString()

);

})();
